subject: SYDE
title: Digital Computation
description: Introduction to digital computation for engineers. Topics include number systems, logic operations, computer organization, programming fundamentals, and problem solving using computational tools.

subject: SYDE
title: Human-Computer Interaction
description: Principles of human-computer interaction. User-centered design, interface evaluation, usability testing, cognitive models, and design of interactive systems.
prerequisites: Level at least 4A in Engineering or CS, or permission of instructor
notes: Elective course; often cross-listed with CS or SE courses

subject: SYDE
title: Image Processing and Visual Communication
description: Fundamentals of digital image processing and visual communication. Topics include sampling, enhancement, restoration, compression, and recognition applications.

subject: SYDE
title: Image Processing and Computer Vision
description: Image analysis, computer vision algorithms, feature detection, segmentation, motion analysis, and pattern recognition.
prerequisites: SYDE 542 or equivalent background in image processing

subject: SYDE
title: Computational Neuroscience
description: Mathematical and computational models of neural systems. Topics include spiking neurons, neural coding, network models, and simulation techniques.
prerequisites: Consent of instructor; background in math and programming expected

subject: SYDE
title: Systems Design Project 1
description: Capstone design project course, part 1. Students work in teams to define, plan, and begin the design of an engineering system.
prerequisites: Level at least 4A in Systems Design Engineering

subject: SYDE
title: Systems Design Project 2
description: Continuation of SYDE 552. Students complete the design, implementation, and testing of their engineering system and present results.

subject: SYDE
title: Optimization Methods
description: Optimization techniques and their applications to engineering design problems. Topics include linear, nonlinear, and combinatorial optimization methods.

subject: SYDE
title: Artificial Intelligence Applications in Engineering
description: Applications of artificial intelligence techniques in engineering design and analysis. Topics include knowledge-based systems, expert systems, and AI optimization.

subject: SYDE
title: Machine Learning
description: Principles and methods of machine learning, including supervised and unsupervised learning, neural networks, support vector machines, and probabilistic models.
prerequisites: STAT 231 or equivalent, and programming background
